title: Cloud Swords
description: A cloud computing themed tech and magic mod where every sword, spell, and machine is inspired by real cloud services. Lambda summons ephemeral allies, S3 stores items, EC2 autoscales damage, and 28 spells cast cloud operations
body:
Cloud Swords Mod
  
  A cloud computing-themed tech & magic mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Fabric)
  
  Ever wondered what AWS Lambda would look like as a Minecraft sword? Or what if your armor progression mirrored
  cloud certification levels? Cloud Swords turns cloud computing concepts into engaging game mechanics — swords with
  service-inspired abilities, spellbooks that cast "cloud operations," machines with energy networks, and a full
  villager economy.
  
  Built for developers, cloud engineers, and gamers who love RPG content mods.
  
  ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  ⚔️ Features
  
  7 Cloud Swords
  
  Each sword represents a cloud service with unique abilities:
  
  - Sword of Lambda — "Invoke": summons 1-3 ephemeral allies (serverless = temporary)
  - Greatsword of Lambda — "Mass Invoke": 3-5 holy allies, two-handed
  - Sword of S3 — "PutObject/GetObject": absorbs items from the ground, stores them in a virtual bucket (persists
  through death)
  - Sword of EC2 — "Auto Scaling": consecutive hits stack +10% damage (max +50%). "Spot Instance": 20% crit chance
  - Sword of CloudWatch — "Describe Alarms": reveals all mobs in 30 blocks
  - Sword of IAM — "Deny Policy": blocks mob special abilities for 8s
  - Sword of DynamoDB — "Burst Capacity": first 5 hits deal increasing damage, then throttles
  
  📖 9 Cloud Spellbooks + 28 Spells
  
  - 3 tiers of tomes (T1/T2/T3) with Spell Engine integration
  - Spells named after cloud operations: Ping, DDoS Flood, Auto Scale, Region Failover, Cloud Nuke
  - Rune consumption system (Packet/Protocol/Quantum runes)
  - Empowered variants with +2 spell power
  - Compatible with Binding Table, Spell Infinity, Spell Power, Spell Haste
  
  🛡️ 4 Armor Sets
  
  - Dataflow (Post-Iron): Speed + Haste, 10% dodge
  - Netherlink (Post-Diamond): Fire Resistance + Strength, 13% dodge
  - Quantum (Post-Netherite): Resistance, 15% dodge
  - Cloudsteel (Endgame): Slow Falling + Jump Boost II, 20% dodge
  - Smithing Table progression: Iron → Diamond → Netherite → Quantum → Cloudsteel
  
  ⚡ Energy System
  
  - Cloud Generator — produces energy from Cloud Shards
  - Internet Cable + Fiber Optic Cable — BFS energy transfer (up to 256 blocks)
  - Wireless Energy — Transmitter/Receiver (radius 8)
  - Energy Storage — 3 tiers (10GB / 50GB / 200GB)
  - Data Melter — 3x3x3 multiblock for advanced material processing
  
  🏘️ 7 Villager Professions
  
  Software Developer, Cloud Architect, Security Engineer, AI Engineer, DevOps Engineer, SysAdmin, Data Engineer —
  each with 5 trade levels and Master-exclusive items purchasable with Cloud Credits.
  
  🐪 Cloud Caravan Merchants
  
  - 3 wandering traders (Packet Runner, Protocol Broker, Quantum Courier) with donkeys + loot chests
  - Elite progression: complete trades to unlock premium items (Elytra, Trident, Totem of Undying)
  - Natural spawning as caravans (1-3 merchants)
  - Never despawn — permanent infrastructure
  
  🌍 World Generation
  
  - Cloud Ore (Overworld), Nether Cloud Ore, End Cloud Ore
  - Loot injection in dungeons, mineshafts, bastions, fortresses, end cities
  - Cloud Office village structure
  
  📗 Quality of Life
  
  - EMI integration (6 custom recipe categories)
  - Patchouli guidebook
  - Animated textures on all items
  - Full English + Spanish localization
  
  ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  🔧 Compatibility
  
  ✅ Tested with Prominence II: Hasturian Era (650+ mods) — no conflicts.
  
  Works alongside: Create, Supplementaries, CTOV, Towns and Towers, Spell Engine, Better Combat, Trinkets,
  Accessories, Zenith, and more.
  
  Optional integrations: Trinkets, Accessories, Spell Engine, Runes, EMI
  
  ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  📦 Dependencies
  
  - Required: Fabric API
  - Optional: Spell Engine, Trinkets, Accessories, Runes, EMI
  
  ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  🎓 Learn Cloud by Playing
  
  This mod isn't just content — it's a learning tool. Every mechanic maps to a real cloud computing concept:
  
  - Lambda sword = serverless ephemeral compute
  - S3 sword = object storage with put/get operations
  - EC2 sword = auto scaling + spot instances
  - Armor progression = cloud certification levels
  - Energy network = distributed systems with BFS routing
  - Villager economy = service catalog with tiered pricing
  - Caravan merchants = cloud marketplace with loyalty programs
  
  Play the game, learn the cloud. ☁️⚔️
